Hi Samantha / Tom —

Thanks again for the interest — excited to show how Redwood can reduce inference cost for FinVest. I know schedules are tight on your side; below are two possible approaches that try to balance your US morning preference and our EU engineering availability:

Option A — Staggered split (recommended)
- 30-min executive overview: 08:00–08:30 ET (13:00–13:30 CET) with Monica + Laura (product + sales)
- 60-min technical deep-dive: recorded hands-on session led by Markus (engineer) scheduled later the same day; we’ll provide the recording and a follow-up 30-min live Q&A at a mutually agreed time.

Option B — Single overlap window
- 90-min session at 14:00 ET / 20:00 CET — full team available but later for your East Coast execs.

I attached a quick agenda (FinVest-demo-agenda-v2.pdf) and a timezone grid (timezone-grid.png) so we can pick the least painful option. If neither works, please propose two 30–90 minute slots on Tue/Wed next week and we’ll prioritize.

Quick ask: which option do you prefer? If Option A, does 08:00 ET for the exec overview work? I can send a calendar invite and a short recording plan.

Cheers,
Monica
